name: The "brain fog has a single root cause you can fix" story
name_rule: Attributed, not asserted (briefs/narratives/SYSTEM.md §3): a name is one more repetition of the claim.
claim: Brain fog and cognitive decline are caused by an identifiable metabolic or dietary root cause (e.g. insulin resistance, 'type 3 diabetes'), and correcting it restores mental clarity.
born_note: The type 3 diabetes framing entered literature in 2005 and reached mass audiences via grain and sugar brain books around 2013. (model estimate, pending audit)

frame.problem: Widespread brain fog and memory decline
frame.cause: Metabolic dysfunction from diet, especially insulin resistance
frame.outcome: Identifying and removing the root cause reverses the fog

explanations.layman: You feel foggy, forgetful and slow, and these videos promise one underlying cause, usually blood sugar or insulin problems, with a fix that restores clarity. Some even link it to Alzheimer's. It matters because real causes of fog include sleep debt, thyroid disease, anaemia, depression and medication effects, and a single-cause story can delay finding yours.
explanations.intermediate: Mechanism: chronic high insulin and impaired brain glucose use starve or inflame neurons, so low-carb or ketogenic eating, fasting and supplements reverse it; hence Alzheimer's as type 3 diabetes. Camps: metabolic-health and functional-medicine creators offering one lever; neurologists and endocrinologists treating fog as a nonspecific symptom with many causes; researchers who accept insulin resistance as a risk factor, not the root.
explanations.expert: Falsification path: trials where ketogenic or insulin-sensitising interventions fail to improve cognition beyond placebo in non-diabetic subjects, plus the mixed intranasal insulin and anti-diabetic Alzheimer's results already on record. Gainers are course and supplement sellers, continuous glucose monitor affiliates and keto brands. Lifecycle: mature and forking, with each channel substituting a new single culprit as the last one loses novelty.
